reviews.classification: complete thematic UI palette and successive styling/native comparison/prose-default adoption history
reviews.disposition:
All 1,291 input lines were read in contiguous bounded ranges: P1–P5/V1–V5, seven theme layers, D8–D12, foundation/UIE/UD, every BD1–BD12/LD1–LD12/UF1–UF10/MC1–MC5 row, IG/RUC/TSG, all 53 checked treatments, full delivery/incidents and UIC/PDC/UPX1–UPX26 through the later adoption notices. Counting the historical checked rows confirms 53 (task-local table receipt), not 53 independent current gameplay proofs. The header's proposal-only status is chronology: later bounded execution, full-palette follow-through, October29 Luminous-default direction and November4 prose/whimsy adoption explicitly supersede it within their scopes. Example copy, optional metadata, remaining research and adjacent systems are not adopted merely because the shared defaults were reconciled.

The useful presentation model combines subject/task, known choices, commitment, work and actual aftermath without forcing one layout or one visual density. Keep independent useful panes, current work and full-height Reports available; a diagram is chosen for its real reading task rather than attached automatically to changed prose. Earlier compact/comfortable modes, one-active-decision wording, perpetual role hues, no-per-panel choices and one-screen promises are recommendations, not laws that override later taste/UR owners. Current UI_RULES targets supersede all older 1366/1440 acceptance matrices. AD42 makes director review optional; a dated human-style gate is not authority to block current dependency-ready work. Old chapter/chat reservations, finite allowance ceilings, loopback URLs/PIDs and launch instructions were not checked as live and grant no new work or paid use.

The thematic layers separate scheme, role, world/place/occasion, actual condition and explicit Appearance. Personal choices and high contrast keep their actual precedence; a hidden world must not fingerprint itself through theme assets, colors, names or menu counts. A cosmetic setting is not fictional control, and a different frame does not implement world laws. Early role-tints-never-per-world and reveal-once-never-again lines are ordinary orientation/cadence defaults under actual means/world/preference dials, not bans on supported exceptions or genuine renewed discoveries. Discovered, usable, relevant, collapsed, pinned and historically observed are different states. Known blocked actions can retain reasons where appropriate; current UR73 also hides ownerless/developer-only refusals rather than promising every unusable command remains visible. First XP, first level-up and a persisted known fact are distinct discovery events.

BD meters preserve valence, units and meaning: full fuel differs from full strain or completed work; time elapsed differs from actual work; pips may be unequal; free/held/proposed stock does not create a reservation. A maximum change is not damage/healing, and a remembered value is not a live remote sensor. LD cues belong to the exact copy, custody/result and occurrence, with support/stop semantics from the actual domain. A small mark, cat expression, dry line or scene may be pleasing without an extra mechanic, but words such as safe, trusted or restored cannot invent an effect. Correct totals alone do not prove correct recent-gain attribution; same-prefix rows, event-versus-now baseline and stable target/focus are real consumer boundaries, not decoration.

MC distinguishes concise wording, equivalent-repeat stacking, batch/return digest, category filtering, follow/hold and Stop recording. Native dynamic loot already has its own game option/stop totals; it is not the same owner as a browser display preference. Detailed/Stack applies only to retained or future records under its explicit policy. Latest100 detail, total occurrence count, visible rows and unread counts are different quantities. Reopening, re-filtering, a font change or a new view cannot reconstruct pruned events or replay loot, cues, damage or knowledge. IG's 12,000-row model probe is not a native performance measurement. The later IG execution notice supersedes its inspection-only table without making every general digest/world/retention proposal implemented.

TSG source and renderer evidence are kept distinct: a CSS family, TTC collection face, bitmap strike, per-glyph fallback and exact pixels are different claims. The selected MS Gothic local face supersedes the early fallback approximation for that tested candidate; prose deliberately uses another face. Office/source bytes remain private optional assets, not public font redistribution or present-install proof. The receipt corrects its undefined save.character.inventory probe to the actual inventories owner, retains the initial missing-dependency setup failure, and records the accidental shared build mutation instead of claiming untouched artifacts. Frozen 2,326-test/browser evidence has its exact source/bundle/state identity; later live edits are not retroactively covered. The style/demo origin and queued preview did not prove foreground delivery or installed-app appearance. Source attribution, artwork identity and unverified donation destination remain with their exact delivery records.

The 53-entry table represents named bounded treatments. Its initial 27 checked/26 open checkpoint is superseded by the subsequent native/solo completion, not erased; TSG5's styled-but-uncommitted trade/craft scope differs from UF6's separately verified native transfer route. Finite processing/craft intent, actual firewood, remembered observations and session return baselines have particular owners and limits, not all-world automation or a complete encounter archive. UIC13's sparse sketch is explicitly rejected as sufficient visual direction evidence; UIC15–UIC22 later supply the populated native-shell comparison while Signal/Folio remain candidates, and live-source freshness warnings retain their snapshot identity. Later actual Luminous default overrides an earlier proposed Signal-general default. No native source, private image/font, package, external page or old server was re-exercised in this reconciliation.

The November4 adoption notices and live DESIGN/UI_RULES excerpts distinguish UI/narrator/flavor whimsy from character motives, competence, knowledge and speech. Preserve a fitting world/scene register, serious clear commitment/recovery, meaningful repeat cadence and optional expressive texture. An attractive example does not supply a missing action, safe recovery/Export, source fact, consequence or a universal word/joke/art quota. Current status of UR76–UR82/UIV remains its own register; this fold does not promote adjacent proposals. Existing historical wording stays historical unless a separately scoped repair is made. UPX26 is a later selected-task candidate, not permission for a bulk prose rewrite or local-model integration.

Use current [DESIGN](../DESIGN.md), [UI_RULES](UI_RULES.md), [PROJECT](../PROJECT.md) and the actual task, Appearance, report, observation and settlement owners. Retain the whole palette, expressive freedom, original failures/corrections and dated deliveries. No font/style/control change, rule adoption, personal-save access, source acquisition, running-worker action, commit or new runtime proof is made here.
reviews.evidence: Actual full1291line read in eight contiguous ranges, including all53 table bindings and final adoption notices. Live scoped DESIGN/UI_RULES excerpts checked; 53checkbox arithmetic recorded. No full reread of those authority owners, linked private captures/font/source, current native app, browser, external reference or old process execution.
reviews.reopen: Use current accepted owner and exact selected task; retain snapshot, private optional font, source-versus-renderer, retention and current-input proof limits. No current styling or palette-completion work is inferred from dated labels.
